description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

MANTECH seeks an Application Developer to support secure mobility systems and their ongoing accreditations. The role combines software development, security monitoring and updates, accreditation documentation, and collaboration with customers and technical teams.
Application Developer supporting software development and mobility-system accreditation through security-control documentation, vulnerability scanning, and secure environment maintenance

Responsibilities:
• Create, update, maintain, and interpret required Body of Evidence (BOE) documentation, including software architecture products, to support ongoing system accreditations
• Collaborate with management, internal technical teams, and Sponsor authorities to successfully navigate the system accreditation process for mobility systems
• Document responses to required controls, maintaining a robust documentation library and network diagrams while formulating policies, procedures, and integrity standards
• Conduct routine vulnerability scanning across all Sponsor networks, monitor and tune software solutions, and implement required security updates per applicable STIGs
• Oversee security event monitoring policies, maintain baseline system configurations, and ensure continuous availability across multiple production and development environments
• Partner with customers and stakeholders to gather user requirements, deliver complete, functional systems, and proactively communicate progress, risks, and options
• Support end-to-end software development projects and recommend approved process or policy improvements to strengthen the overall security posture

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree and 1 year of experience
• Experience with JavaScript, Java, Oracle P/SQL, and Perl
• Ability to work independently as a member of a geographically diverse team
• Must have a current/active Secret clearance

Preferred:
• Active Security+ CE or other DoD 8570 IAT Level II compliant certification with previous experience supporting cyber security mitigation strategies
• High School Diploma/GED with 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in Information Systems Security and hands-on experience contributing as part of an Agile development team
• Significant experience navigating the Sponsor's accreditation process and ICD 503 requirements, especially as it relates to creating A&A Body of Evidence (BOE) documentation
• Demonstrated hands-on technical experience with Red Hat Linux, .NET 4.x, Apache Tomcat, Apache 2.4, IIS 10, Oracle (12g/19C), and SQL Server (2012/2019)
• Experience working across large teams to drive security agendas for complex, intertwined systems, while inventorying networks and managing network security compliance, patching, and centralized authentication
• Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex IT, network, and security documentation in a dynamic environment
• Proven problem-solving skills with a high level of motivation, adaptability to learn new technologies, and the ability to work independently within a geographically diverse team
